messages:
morgan: Hey team — opened #5123 updating the SDK snippet and a tiny migration guide. CI preview failed on linkcheck + vale. Anyone around to triage?

sara: I can take a look in ~30m. quick glance at the build log?

morgan: paste from preview bot:
```
deploy-preview-bot: Preview build failed for PR #5123
- docs/guide/migration.md: linkcheck: broken link to /api/v1/sdk/init -> 404
- docs/snippets/python.md: vale: V200 passive-voice: "was added" at line 34
- docs/snippets/python.md: mdspell: possible typo 'instantiationg' -> 'instantiating'
```

jonathan: Ugh the snippet change probably added a relative link to the old anchor. I moved that anchor in the migration guide last week.

liam: If the link is to /api/v1/sdk/init we should prefer absolute path with versioned redirect: `/docs/reference/sdk/init` — that fixes linkcheck and is stable for the site.

morgan: Good call. Also for Vale we should rewrite the snippet sentence to active voice instead of adding a suppress line. Example: change "A client was added by creating..." -> "Create a client by calling..."

sara: I'll push two commits: one to fix the anchor/link and one tiny wording + spell fix. Want me to force a retry after?

morgan: Yes please. Can we land in the late merge window (tonight 11pm PT) — site builds are quiet then and it avoids blocking the release cutover.

jonathan: I'm on call for merge approvals around then. If you ping I'll review quickly.  :thumbsup:

liam: One more thought: the docs preview CI sometimes flakes on the large TOC; if linkcheck still fails we can add a short-term `linkcheck-exceptions` entry in the PR (but prefer fix).

sara: ok pushing patch now, will run `./scripts/ci retry-preview pr/5123` after CI picks up.

devex-bot: Build started for preview PR #5123 (commit: 4b9c2d7) — running linkcheck, vale, mdspell

morgan: thanks. if devex-bot still complains about vale rules after wording change, we can ask docs-eng to add a transient rule exception for V200 on snippets folder while we complete the snippet style migration.

sara: CI returned: linkcheck ✅, mdspell ✅, vale ✅ — all green on preview. pushing merge request to main.

jonathan: Reviewing now. small nit on code fence formatting (triple backticks with language tag). I'll approve and merge in the 11pm slot.

morgan: Amazing — thanks everyone. I'll update the migration tracking ticket to note the anchor moved and the SDK snippet wording standardized.

liam: FYI I'll follow up with a short note for the Release channel reminding folks about the merge window.

morgan: done, thanks :rocket:
__notes: This thread captures a small docs PR triage: linkcheck + vale + spellcheck failures, quick fixes, CI retry, and merge timing coordination. Format follows agents.md: single string thread with messages prefixed by sender name. No title field.
